title: SceneAxi credit pack catalog (v1)
description: The one canonical list of purchasable credit packs. Test mode only: live price ids belong to a later captain go-live decision and are not committed. The canonical artifact is contracts/credit-packs.fixtures.json; pnpm check:contracts keeps the docs/auth-credits.md table in exact lockstep with it. Deliberately expressed in the JSON Schema subset scripts/check-contracts.mjs supports, so the gate validates it directly.

mode.description: Constant: only test-mode packs are committed to the repository.

packId.description: Stable pack slug referenced by checkout intents and webhook events.

credits.description: Credits granted when a checkout for this pack completes.

unitAmount.description: Price in the currency's minor unit (e.g. cents), as Stripe expects.

stripePriceId.description: Test-mode Stripe price id. Not a secret: price ids are public identifiers, unlike API keys, which live only in env.
